flagged.evidence: The proof says “Fubini [F3]”. Facts [F3] identifies nonnegative C¹ change of variables; Fubini is [F4], whose cited theorem concerns integrable product integrals. Thus [F3] is the wrong citation for factoring the Gaussian moments. The step’s concluding reference list separately includes [F4], but that does not make the explicit citation accurate.

The proof evaluates the translated Gaussian integral “by [F4], [F5], and affine scaling [F6]”. Facts [F5] is the chain rule and derivative of the exponential, and [F6] is integration by parts and the second fundamental theorem; neither licenses affine scaling. The change-of-variables rule is [F3], while the Gaussian integral and product-integral rules are [F1]–[F2].
